title: in Base overlays, mention an importer that covers a new exported symbol, so "no test covers it" on the defining package is not misread

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The gate reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261127-194957-90f9, project ork, item S538:

in Base overlays, mention an importer that covers a new exported symbol, so "no test covers it" on the defining package is not misread

Evidence: overlay-1 says no daemon test covers runs.go, but internal/cli fails to build without daemon.PausedNext and TestRenderWaitPausesUsePausedNext covers it
